reference.role: STRUCTURE / safe art opening only; new Limited visual identity

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / transparent game UI frame asset.
Create ONE premium LIMITED-edition mercenary card BORDER FRAME for the Korean fantasy game Soopketmon PROJECT V. Exact native 1024x1536 RGBA PNG, portrait 2:3. TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Both the huge interior artwork window and all space outside the border must have real 0-alpha transparency. Show only the physical border ornament; no illustration, colored backdrop, smoky backdrop, black fill, gradient inside the opening, checkerboard painted into the image, or drop shadow across the opening.

The supplied old mercenary frame is a STRUCTURAL REFERENCE ONLY for a slim 2:3 overlay and unobstructed center. Make a fresh exclusive Limited design with a noticeably different visual identity, not a recolor of the old gold/silver laurel frame.

DESIGN:
Luxurious slim beveled PLATINUM metal frame with a dark graphite enamel inner line, restrained iridescent pale-cyan and violet prism inlays. Sophisticated 2D fantasy-game painted metal matching premium character cards. Crisp clean reflective edges, coherent upper-left lighting, carefully balanced four corners. No chunky medieval vines, skulls, angel wings, giant crystals, heavy industrial machinery, or scattered disconnected embellishments.
The corners use elegantly interlocking tapered metallic chevrons and tiny diamond-shaped translucent cyan-violet prism accents, with only a few delicate engraved diagonal lines. A small exclusive geometric emblem centered on the top bridge: two slender interlocking chevrons encircling one small glowing prism, no letters or logos. Subtle cyan light travels in a hairline inside the metal, violet visible only in a few prism reflections; elegant premium collectible treatment, not excessive bloom or a neon box.

GEOMETRY / ART SAFE AREA:
Canvas 1024 wide x1536 high. Frame outer boundaries approximately x20..1004, y24..1512. Vertical rails only about 22–30 px thick, leaving a very wide completely transparent art window. Corner ornaments may extend inward to x80/y115 at top, and x80/y1420 at bottom, but no farther. The top-center emblem stays entirely within y24..125 and about 100 px wide. Make the whole rectangle well aligned, symmetric border thickness, no perspective tilt. Straight side rails, slight elegant beveled corner transitions, not an oval.
Bottom center: a very slim blank dark graphite nameplate, about 440 px wide and 42 px tall, centered around y1470 with a platinum thin bevel, compatible with separate HTML lettering. No lettering generated. Bottom ornament should be no taller than 90px overall, preserving the legs and weapon. No opaque glass panel or vignette in the main opening.

The interior rectangle x100..924, y140..1400 must be entirely transparent, with NO pixels except transparent alpha, because character art will be placed underneath. All effects, glints and tiny light accents are confined tightly to the frame metal. Entire frame fully inside the canvas with transparent padding; no clipped corners.

Output the single border asset alone. High-resolution clean anti-aliased edge pixels and true transparency. No text, LIMITED lettering, SS rank, character name, serial number, typography, UI button, watermark, signature, mockup, character, sample illustration, background or montage. The separate preview will add exact text and characters later.
